source: Conformance was run on the combined VALUES worktree, including the separately deferred UPDATE FROM changes. This diff records only result metadata changes.
before: Four cases returned incorrect first-row collation or CAST-affinity results.
intermediate: Replacing placeholders with first-row expressions also required considering later VALUES rows when deriving compound storage classes; the conflicting-row regression is retained.
semantics: Preserve first-row expressions as result metadata. Retain CAST affinity unless later row types conflict. Treat multirow VALUES without declared types conservatively when combining compound inputs.
version_note: A first exploratory expected result used the system SQLite library. Final expectations were checked against the repository SQLite 3.50.4 binary; multirow VALUES collation/type behavior can differ between those versions.
performance: No new performance parity claim. The final original-baseline comparison is outstanding.
